title: Title & Registration Services State Fee Components, Collection and Refund Periods
content:
For each Title & Registration Services service type, Title Accounting collects from the buyer the state fees listed below, taken from the registration state's fee schedule, with the lien recording fee added whenever a lienholder is recorded on the order.

## 1. Fee components collected

| Service type | State fees collected for the service |
|---|---|
| Kestrel Title-Only Service | title fee; temp tag fee |
| Kestrel In-State Plate Transfer | title fee; registration fee; plate transfer fee; temp tag fee |
| Kestrel In-State New Registration | title fee; registration fee; new plate fee; temp tag fee |
| Kestrel Out-of-State Registration | title fee; registration fee; new plate fee; temp tag fee |
| Kestrel Out-of-State Registration with Inspection | title fee; registration fee; new plate fee; temp tag fee |
| Kestrel Specialty Plate Registration | title fee; registration fee; new plate fee; specialty plate fee; temp tag fee |

## 2. Collection and refund terms

| Service type | State temp tag fee on an extension tag collected from the customer | Specialty plate fee collected with the other state fees at signing | Fee shortage collection period (calendar days after a fee-shortage rejection) | Refund period for held state fees (business days) | State fees already remitted refunded on cancellation after submission |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Title-Only Service | No | No | 7 | 10 | No |
| Kestrel In-State Plate Transfer | No | No | 7 | 10 | No |
| Kestrel In-State New Registration | No | No | 7 | 10 | No |
| Kestrel Out-of-State Registration | No | No | 7 | 10 | No |
| Kestrel Out-of-State Registration with Inspection | No | No | 7 | 10 | No |
| Kestrel Specialty Plate Registration | No | Yes | 7 | 10 | No |

The refund period runs in business days from the cancellation, or from the day an overcollection is identified.

## Notes to the schedule

- No service type collects the state temp tag fee for an extension tag from the customer.
- Only Kestrel Specialty Plate Registration collects the specialty plate fee at signing, together with the other state fees.
- Hypothetical illustration: a Kestrel In-State New Registration order with a recorded lienholder collects five state fees (title, registration, new plate, temp tag and lien recording); the same order with no lienholder collects four.
